class.name: VolumetricCloudsEffect
class.brief_description: Volumetric clouds rendered as a compositor effect.
class.description: Ray marches a cloud layer around a planet with compute shaders and composites it over the scene after the transparent pass. Add it to [member Compositor.compositor_effects] to use it. This requires a [RenderingDevice], so it does not work with the Compatibility renderer.

members.member: Tiling noise the cloud density is sampled from. The red channel holds the Perlin-Worley noise that gives the clouds their shape, and the green, blue and alpha channels hold Worley noise of increasing frequency that erodes their edges.
World space direction pointing towards the sun. It does not need to be normalized, but it cannot be a zero vector.
How brightly the sun lights the clouds.
